item.title: Turn open ends into insight: Coding Open Ends in Crunch
item.description:
Benefits

  • Faster coding: Crunch uses AI to find the main themes in your responses and assign each response to a category, so the work takes minutes, not days.
  • Consistent results: Save your categories as a taxonomy and reuse it on the same dataset or a different one. That keeps waves, markets, and studies comparable.
  • You stay in control: Review, rename, merge, or adjust categories before you use them in your analysis.

How does it work?

Open a dataset and find the open text variable you want to code. Select Categorize responses from the variable menu.
